summary.zh: 团队编制工具。暴露 team:create_role / team:list_roles 两个工具:当 Forge 的队友名单里没有合适角色时,由 Forge 自己铸造一个新队友——写一份 agent-pack 到用户可写插件层(默认全局 L1),reload 后新角色立刻进 roster、跨会话、跨重启、不污染仓库,随后 delegate_to_subagent 即可派它。让「模型知道怎么用插件」延伸到「模型知道怎么创建角色」。
summary.en: The team-forge tool. Exposes team:create_role / team:list_roles: when no suitable role exists in Forge's roster, Forge mints a new teammate — writing an agent-pack into the user-writable plugin layer (global L1 by default). After a reload the role instantly joins the roster (cross-session, cross-restart, no repo pollution) and delegate_to_subagent can dispatch it. Extends 'the model knows how to use plugins' into 'the model knows how to create roles'.

body.zh:
team:create_role → 铸造新队友(agent-pack → L1/L2)
team:list_roles → 列出现有可派单角色
创建持久、跨会话、撞名即拒(不覆盖)
body.en:
team:create_role → mint a teammate (agent-pack → L1/L2)
team:list_roles → list dispatchable roles
Persistent, cross-session, duplicate-id rejected

body.zh: Forge(主线制作人)—— 名单里缺角色时先造再派
body.en: Forge (lead producer) — create then delegate when a role is missing
